summary: PASS: 8 fleet XP boxes (.110 .123 .124 .133 .143 .171 .184 + host .240) were in ONE Red Alert 2 LAN match on Arctic Circle (2-8). Proof: the host's in-match Diplomacy roster names all 8 Fleet<octet> players, and fresh frames at 16:56 show each box on its own base on the same map, with no disconnect dialog. .186 and .243 are NA. The game was then closed on all 8 boxes.
issues: Graceful close did not work: RA2 ignored WM_CLOSE in-game on all 8 boxes, so lanparty forced game.exe and ra2.exe after 12 s. No processes are left, no crash dialog appeared, and every desktop is back at its normal mode (e.g. .240 1920x1080, .110 1600x1200, .184 1024x768).
The [MultiPlayer] Handle preset in the launcher's RA2.INI has no effect: the lobby name field came up empty, and the round agent typed each name by hand. ScenIndex=27 (Arctic Circle) does work.
Peer traffic was not sniffed (the switched LAN gives no view of box-to-box UDP from .132). The proof is the host's roster plus each joiner's frame.
library_fix_needed: RedAlert2 launcher: the RA2.INI [MultiPlayer] Handle=Fleet<octet> preset is not applied in the Network lobby. Find the key RA2 actually reads for the LAN name (or accept typing it by hand).
